edges.claim: The current SBI VC Trade page says monthly points are converted by month-end into the selected crypto asset and credited to a same-name active VCTRADE account.
XRP is one of three selectable assets per card; one asset is selected for each card.

The current product page displays an application window ending 2026-10-31, eligible spend through 2026-12-05 and crypto reward delivery by the end of 2027-02; campaign selection priority applies when multiple cards are held.
The product page describes crypto rewards linked to SBI Securities credit-card mutual-fund accumulation; actual XRP selection and amounts are unknown.

hypotheses.statement: The card's monthly reward mechanism can create recurring XRP account credits when the cardholder selects XRP.
disconfirming_evidence: No XRP selection share or aggregate credit volume is disclosed.
Points expire if the required same-name active VCTRADE account is absent at conversion.
hypotheses.next_test: Seek monthly aggregate XRP reward credits or disclosed customer counts and selection shares.

hypotheses.statement: SBI purchases XRP on the public spot market to fund card rewards.
disconfirming_evidence: The page specifies SBI VC Trade's sales-price reference, not a trade execution or inventory source.
Rewards could be funded from existing inventory, OTC or internal transfers.
hypotheses.next_test: Require public inventory, market execution, OTC or treasury sourcing evidence.

notes: The current September–December 2026 campaign is separate from the expired May–August launch campaign.
The displayed sales-price reference is not an execution record.
The campaign's multiple-card priority rule can direct campaign rewards to Gold before Standard and BTC before ETH before XRP.
No actual capital or directional price inference is admitted.
